rule: Every production adapter (a non-Protocol class in proofrail/ or integrations/ defining execute() or observe()) must declare tests that exercise it against its real component, or a recorded capture of it, and must name that component. A hand-built stand-in for the component does not count. scripts/check_adapter_e2e.py enforces this in CI.

integrations/openclaw/github_adapter.py:.real_component: Live GitHub REST API: responses recorded by scripts/live_github_merge_trial.py in evidence/live-github-2026-10-19/results.json

integrations/openclaw/database_adapter.p.real_component: Real SQLite database files on disk

integrations/openclaw/bridge.py:Subproce.real_component: Real child processes with on-disk side effects

proofrail/quorum.py:QuorumObservationAda.real_component: Signed observer attestations reconciled through the real HTTP control plane

integrations/openclaw/repository_change..real_component: Real scripts/xzenia-coder-dispatch, a real worker process and a real git repository

excluded.proofrail/demo.py:_RecordingAdapter: Private offline demo fixture; not a production adapter.
excluded.proofrail/demo.py:_ReconcilingFalseSucce: Private offline demo fixture demonstrating a lying executor.
